description: This Java class defines configurable properties for Vertx, including options for native transport, metrics, event loop execution time, and DNS query timeout, and provides a method to configure VertxOptions accordingly.

classes.name: VertxProperties
classes.description: A class encapsulating properties for configuring Vertx instances, including options for native transport, metrics, event loop execution time, and DNS timeout.

methods.name: setPreferNative
methods.description: Sets whether to prefer native transport for Vertx.

methods.name: setEnableMetrics
methods.description: Enables or disables Vertx's metrics collection.

methods.name: setMaxEventLoopExecuteTime
methods.description: Sets the maximum event loop execute time in milliseconds.

methods.name: setDnsQueryTimeout
methods.description: Sets the DNS query timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: configureVertx
methods.description: Configures and returns a VertxOptions object based on the current properties.
